map.Bolomey：W/C = (α·f_c × γ_c)/(f_c + α·γ_c: Bolomey: W/C = (α·f_c × γ_c)/(f_c + α·γ_c × γ_w); volume ratio derived from W/C and sand ratio
map.依据 Bolomey 公式，按强度等级、水泥标号与骨料类型计算水灰比，再据用水量: By the Bolomey formula, from strength grade, cement grade and aggregate type compute the water-cement ratio, then by water amount and sand ratio get per-m³ cement, water, sand and stone amounts.
map.💡 Bolomey 公式：fcu,0 = A·fce·(C/W − B)，其中: 💡 Bolomey formula: fcu,0 = A·fce·(C/W − B), where fce = cement grade × 1.13; design strength fcu,0 = fcu,k + 1.645σ; W/C = A·fce ÷ (fcu,0 + A·B·fce). Crushed stone A=0.53,B=0.20; gravel A=0.49,B=0.13.

map.配制强度 fcu0=fcu,k+1.645σ（σ 随等级取 4/5/6）；水泥实: Design strength fcu0=fcu,k+1.645σ (σ by grade 4/5/6); actual cement strength fce=grade×1.13; W/C=A·fce÷(fcu0+A·B·fce), crushed stone A=0.53/B=0.20, gravel A=0.49/B=0.13; cement=water÷W/C; total aggregate=2400−water−cement; sand=total aggregate×sand ratio, stone=the rest.
map.C30、42.5 水泥、碎石、水 195 kg、砂率 34%：σ=5，fcu0=: C30, 42.5 cement, crushed stone, water 195 kg, sand ratio 34%: σ=5, fcu0=30+1.645×5=38.225, fce=42.5×1.13=48.025, W/C=0.5876, cement=195÷0.5876≈331.8 kg, total aggregate≈1873.2 kg, sand≈636.9 kg, stone≈1236.3 kg (per-m³ amounts).
map.碎石和卵石的系数差很多吗？: Do crushed and gravel coefficients differ much?
map.碎石 A=0.53/B=0.20、卵石 A=0.49/B=0.13；同强度下碎石: Crushed stone A=0.53/B=0.20, gravel A=0.49/B=0.13; at the same strength crushed stone needs a larger W/C and slightly less cement, gravel the opposite; wrong aggregate type directly changes the mix.
